name: Durian sugarcane juice
summary: Sugarcane juice along National Highway 22, cool, with the aroma of durian. Mung bean is also used in place of the fruit.
howToEat: Drink it along National Highway 22. The mix is sugarcane with durian, or sugarcane with mung bean.
seoTitle: Durian sugarcane juice in Cu Chi
seoDescription: Cool sugarcane juice along National Highway 22, with durian or with mung bean.
taste: Cool sugarcane with the aroma of durian, or of mung bean.
